preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The integer k must be between 1 and the minimum of 10^18 or the length of Kyoya's list l.
The input must consist of exactly two integers n and k separated by whitespace.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Every element in the output permutation must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: sorted(stdout.split()) == [str(i) for i in range(1, n+1)]
postconditions.description: The output must be a permutation of the integers from 1 to n.

The output permutation must be the k-th permutation in Kyoya's list, where Kyoya's list is the lexicographically ordered list of all permutations of length n that remain unchanged when their standard cyclic representation is converted back to a permutation by removing parentheses.
